## Change and reason

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior/documentation.

## Traceability

Canonical requirement IDs, actual issue IDs, supervisor comment IDs (if relevant), and related PRs.

## Evidence

Distinguish documented targets from implemented/tested behavior. Record actual checks, build/date/conditions and limitations. For Word changes, summarize content changes and render/visual verification. For architecture changes, update report, diagrams, API/schema/privacy and verification sources together.

## Remaining work

List pending review, hardware, research, implementation or evaluation without marking it completed.
